title: IdentifiedItem
description: One grocery item recognized by the vision model. Wire type only: this is what the model emits and what the scan pipeline consumes; it is never persisted directly. Source of record: DinnerDecider/Services/LLM/LLMService.swift:7-17 (struct IdentifiedItem: Codable, Hashable, Sendable). The identify-item prompt returns a single object of this shape; identify-all-items returns an array of them.

name.description: Item name as the model reports it, e.g. "Whole Milk". The literal value "unknown" (compared case-insensitively) is the model's no-item escape hatch and is filtered out by the pipeline. Also the basis of the dedupe key (see shared/pipeline/scan-pipeline.md).

brand.description: Brand read off the packaging, or null when there is none / it is unreadable. Swift decodes this with decodeIfPresent, so an ABSENT key and an explicit null are both valid and both produce nil. Part of the dedupe key.

category.description: Raw category string from the model. NOT validated at decode time: any string decodes successfully and is mapped to the FoodCategory enum later, lowercased, falling back to "other" for anything unrecognized. See shared/taxonomy/categories.md. The enum values are listed under examples, but they are not an enforced constraint.

confidence.description: Model confidence, prompted as 0-1. NOT range-validated at decode time in Swift (it is a plain Double). The pipeline drops any item with confidence < 0.15. The dedupe step keeps the highest-confidence sighting of a given name+brand.
